title: Differentiable Thermodynamic Phase-Equilibria for Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.11249v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate prediction of phase equilibria remains a central challenge in chemical engineering. Physics-consistent machine learning methods that incorporate thermodynamic structure into neural networks have recently shown strong performance for activity-coefficient modeling. However, extending such approaches to equilibrium data arising from an extremum principle, such as liquid-liquid equilibria, remains difficult. Here we present DISCOMAX, a differentiable algorithm for phase-equilibrium calculation that guarantees thermodynamic consistency at both training and inference, only subject to a user-specified discretization. The method combines discrete enumeration of feasible phase states with masked softmax aggregation in the backward pass, with the propagation of the true equilibrium state in the forward pass, using a straight-through gradient estimator to enable physics-consistent end-to-end learning of neural \gls{gE}-models. translated_title: 用于机器学习的可微分热力学相平衡
translated_abstract: 相平衡的精确预测仍是化学工程中的核心挑战。将热力学结构融入神经网络的物理一致机器学习方法，近期在活度系数建模中展现出强大性能。然而，将此类方法扩展到源于极值原理（如液-液平衡）的平衡数据仍然困难。在此，我们提出DISCOMAX，一种可微分的相平衡计算算法，它在训练和推理时均保证热力学一致性，仅受用户指定的离散化限制。该方法将可行相态的离散枚举与反向传播中的掩码softmax聚合相结合，在前向传播中传播真实平衡态，并使用直通梯度估计器实现神经gE模型的物理一致端到端学习。我们展示了其性能。
tldr: 本文提出DISCOMAX，一种可微分相平衡计算算法，通过离散枚举和掩码softmax聚合结合直通梯度估计器，确保训练和推理时的热力学一致性，实现端到端学习。
en_tdlr: This paper presents DISCOMAX, a differentiable phase-equilibrium algorithm that ensures thermodynamic consistency during training and inference via discrete enumeration, masked softmax aggregation, and a straight-through gradient estimator, enabling end-to-end learning.
